* [[Thengen]] ([[Port Sledge]]) 
* [[Dakk]] ([[Ember Light Camp]])

== Notes ==
* Combines well with [[Foul Feast]], [[Cautery Signet]] and [[Martyr]].
* Combines well with [[Cultist's Fervor]] and [[Signet of Suffering]].
* You do not ''gain'' conditions, but you do ''lose'' them. Thus you trigger [[Fragility]] only once, and do not trigger abilities like [[Contagion]].
* This skill is the only way to prevent [[Dazed]] and the interrupt from its application. This is also the only way for a player to become immune to [[Poison]], [[Deep Wound]], [[Weakness]], [[Bleeding]] and [[Cracked Armor]].
{{bug|This skill ''does'' transfer [[Bleeding]], [[Disease]], and [[Poison]] to [[minion]]s, despite them being non-[[fleshy]].}}

== Trivia ==
* The minion in the skill icon is a [[Bone Horror]].
